name: Ribera del Júcar

known.via: English Wikipedia "Ribera del Júcar" (a wine place on Wikidata)

terms: Denominación de Origen, Spain's main quality tier.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A DO along the Júcar River in Cuenca province, covering seven municipalities. Allowed grapes include Tempranillo, Bobal, Syrah and Cabernet Sauvignon for red, and Airén, Macabeo, Verdejo and Sauvignon Blanc for white.
